summary: Twelve records whose latest dated event predated June 2026 were re-researched for later developments and each current stage was tested against possible reversals. No stage changed. Eight records gained evidence and were independently reviewed: withdrawal dates for international bodies are now tied to UN depositary notifications and agency releases; the fiscal year 2027 defense authorization votes were added to three defense records; the stopgap appropriations law enacted 2026-09-02 was read and carries no public broadcasting funding; and the court status of the State Department reorganization record moved from enjoined to pending. Four records (c02-06, c07-03, c09-03, c09-04) were checked without change.
title: Freshness pass: 12 records with the oldest evidence rechecked
